name: Wikidata — items with coordinates in Sylhet Division (places, not administrative units)
attribution: Wikidata (CC0 1.0). Wikipedia article links are references only; no article text is copied.
notes: Division item Q459732. Candidates: P625 inside each district bounding box (wikibase:box) plus P131-chain members of the division item; kept when a point lies inside the HDX COD-AB division polygon (hdx_cod_ab_bgd_sylhet/boundaries.geojson). District/upazila by point-in-polygon, seed names via hdx_cod_ab_bgd_sylhet/crosswalk.csv. Administrative units and settlements excluded. Community-edited data: every row is unverified. P1329 phone numbers kept in extra_json.wikidata_phone only (not published by the institution itself).
